$comment: Shared table for the group numbering of an HDF component's string maps on an OSCAL assessment subject (ADR-0014 §4.5): one prop group per map entry, numbered from 1 in sorted key order. Go sorts map keys bytewise over their UTF-8 encoding, which is Unicode code-point order; JavaScript's Array.prototype.sort compares UTF-16 code units, which orders a supplementary-plane key (>= U+10000, encoded as a lead surrogate in [U+D800,U+DBFF]) before a BMP key in [U+E000,U+FFFF] instead of after it. `order` is the code-point order both languages must emit, so group N is the key at index N-1. Read by Go (component_props_test.go, hdf-to-oscal-sar/go/converter_test.go) and TypeScript (component-props.test.ts, hdf-to-oscal-sar/typescript/converter.test.ts).

cases.label: ascii keys
cases.why: control case: UTF-16 and code-point order agree over ASCII

cases.label: astral key against an ascii key
cases.why: control case: a lead surrogate (U+D83D) still sorts after ASCII under both orders

cases.label: astral key against a fullwidth BMP key
cases.why: U+FF5E (65374) precedes U+1F600 (128512) by code point, but its UTF-16 unit follows the lead surrogate U+D83D (55357)

cases.label: astral key against a BMP private-use key
cases.why: U+F8FF (63743) precedes U+1F600 by code point and follows it under UTF-16 code units

cases.label: mixed ascii, BMP private-use, fullwidth and astral keys
cases.why: the astral key takes the last group under code-point order and the third under UTF-16 code units

cases.label: shared prefix, differing length
cases.why: a prefix sorts before its extensions, and 'i' (105) before 's' (115)
